page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.3xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 12 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 24.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core execution. Single-core performance is relatively weak, with stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling in the bottom 10% to 25% of tested instances. However, the 12 dedicated physical cores deliver average multi-core performance, as evidenced by middle-tier results in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, Geekbench multi-core tests, and Passmark CPU benchmarks. Memory bandwidth remains average, though the Passmark memory score is positioned in the lower 25%.

Given the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and the absence of local storage, this instance is suited for multi-threaded compute workloads that do not require high single-thread performance or massive memory footprints. Appropriate workloads include parallel software compilation, multi-threaded text and image processing, and moderate database operations, such as Redis caching. It is less suitable for single-threaded tasks, high-throughput static web serving, or large-scale LLM inference.
